name: shoot.create
description: A shoot planned from ideas, or added by hand, under the client's id: on the day given or the first day ahead with no shoot, 12:00 to 17:00 unless hours are given. The ideas leave the shoots they were in, and a planned shoot left with none goes. The same id again answers with the shoot it made.
sql:
with fresh as (select not exists (select 1 from brandbase.shoots where id = :id) as yes),
x as (
  select coalesce(:day::date, brandbase.free_shoot_day(:brand, brandbase.today(:brand, :now::timestamptz))) as day,
    brandbase.hours_after('12:00', '17:00', :start, :end) as h, array(select i from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(:ideaIds::jsonb, '[]')) with ordinality t(i, n) group by i order by min(n)) as ideas
),
emptied as (
  delete from brandbase.shoots s
  where (select yes from fresh) and s.brand_id = :brand and s.origin = 'planned' and s.id <> :id
    and cardinality(array(select i from unnest(s.idea_ids) i where i <> all (array(select unnest(x.ideas) from x)))) = 0
  returning s.id
),
taken as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = array(select i from unnest(s.idea_ids) i where i <> all (array(select unnest(x.ideas) from x))),
    version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where (select yes from fresh) and s.brand_id = :brand and s.id <> :id and s.idea_ids && array(select unnest(x.ideas) from x)
    and s.id not in (select id from emptied)
  returning s.id
),
made as (
  insert into brandbase.shoots (id, brand_id, title, origin, day, start, "end", place, idea_ids)
  select :id, :brand, btrim(:title), :origin, x.day, x.h[1], x.h[2], coalesce(:place, ''), x.ideas
  from x, fresh where fresh.yes
  on conflict (id) do nothing
  returning *
),
people as (
  insert into brandbase.crew (id, shoot_id, brand_id, name, role, position)
  select c ->> 'id', m.id, :brand, btrim(c ->> 'name'), btrim(c ->> 'role'), (n - 1)::int
  from made m, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(:crew::jsonb, '[]')) with ordinality t(c, n)
  returning *
)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(m), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from people p), '[]')) as result from made m
union all
select brandbase.shoot_json(s) from brandbase.shoots s, fresh where not fresh.yes and s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
